_about: VanaSync's shared catalog (2026-11-27, J's Radio handoff). Every bundled track belongs to one numbered set. group: gameplay (Battle Themes, activities, zone music: never in Radio) or album (artist and community albums: Radio may shuffle them). role says what a gameplay track is for. id: the first 32 hex digits of the file's sha256, as battle-pack.json seeds it. title/artist here are the approved credit and win over the file's own tags. New sets: add them here (and their files to battle-pack.json); the player lists them without any change to its code.
